name: Telcoin MXN
oneLiner: eMXN is Telcoin's centralized Mexican peso stablecoin on Polygon, backed by MXN reserves managed by Telcoin and used for Digital Cash payments.
collateral: Mexican-peso Digital Cash reserve backing managed by Telcoin for eMXN issued on Polygon
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed Mexican-peso Digital Cash stablecoin used for payments and settlement in the Telcoin Wallet; Telcoin's Terms of Use effective 2026-06-30 (section XXIX) document a 1:1 redemption policy for verified Telcoin Account holders (0.15% fee, $2,000 per-transaction cap, 1-3 business days standard), but no eMXN-specific reserve-attestation report has been published

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Telcoin's Terms of Use effective 2026-06-30, section XXIX, establish eMXN as an eXYZ token issued by Telcoin LLC, backed by an equivalent or greater value of fiat currency or currency equivalents held in segregated accounts at regulated financial institutions, apart from Telcoin's corporate operating account, with a documented 1:1 redemption policy for verified account holders. This issuer-managed fiat-reserve claim structure matches the fiat-cash archetype; the bank-issued eUSD under Telcoin Digital Asset Bank is a separate product governed by separate terms. No independent assurance engagement, named reserve institution, or custody-continuity disclosure has been published, so the mechanism component reviews remain bounded.

sources.label: Telcoin Terms of Use (effective 2026-06-30), section XXIX eXYZ Terms
